title_en: On the edge of Se Kavaje Street, Super Apartment 2+1 Newly Invested for sale!!!
description_en: On the edge of Kavaje street, at Polyclinic no. 9, Super Apartment 2+1 with perfect location for sale!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of an existing building with a net area of ​​64 m2 and is organized in a spacious corridor that distributes through the other rooms, starting with the living room together with the cooking area and exiting to the balcony, two spacious rooms, a bathroom with windows and a balcony. The orientation is from the South-West, which means that there is natural light throughout the day. The area where it is located is quite preferred both for residence and for investment, being very close to the center and the rental values ​​in this area are high. It has every possible facility such as nurseries, kindergartens, schools and any other service. The environment has recently been invested: parquet flooring, plumbing and electrical installations, doors, windows, etc. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
